integrity_notes: Finite enumeration and rational Gram calculations independently corroborate a self-contained finite combinatorial proof. Exact normalization and equality cases are explicit. Independent external validation has not occurred.
scientific_limitations: Proved for the canonical Petersen graph and the inherited ten-coordinate Euclidean norm only; no general Kneser-family extension. Related graph-spread literature may contain equivalent descriptions, and one plausible full text could not be inspected.
title: Exact inradius and contact-facet rigidity of the Petersen symmetric edge polytope
